skill.name: William Research A Skill
skill.oneLiner: Researches a skill's topic and writes research/notes.md before anyone drafts design.md or SKILL.md.

failureHypotheses.failure: bundle.json's oneLiner and design.md's Intent are both empty, and the agent invents a topic and researches it anyway instead of stopping (design.md failure hypothesis #1)
Revise notes from a prior review are silently ignored in favor of re-researching from scratch (design.md failure hypothesis #2)
A stated-but-unconfident fact is written into research/notes.md as if it were settled, with no hedge or open-question flag (design.md failure hypothesis #3)
The agent edits files outside research/ (design.md failure hypothesis #4)
research/notes.md restates the topic and platitudes with no concrete, checkable facts or edge cases (design.md failure hypothesis #5)
